summary: Backend-only testing of email client bug fixes. Verified: 1) _resolve_folder function exists and uses FOLDER_ALTERNATIVES, 2) _connect_imap has improved error handling for decryption/auth/connection failures, 3) API endpoints return proper 404 for non-existent accounts, 4) Frontend code review confirms serialized loading pattern and error handling. All 14 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Full IMAP functionality cannot be tested without real email account credentials in the database. Code review confirms all fixes are correctly implemented.

success_rate.frontend: Code review verified - serialized loading and error handling implemented correctly

test_credentials: No email accounts configured in preview environment
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email client module bug fixes verified via code review and API endpoint testing. Cannot fully test IMAP operations without email accounts in DB. Key fixes: 1) _resolve_folder tries FOLDER_ALTERNATIVES for Gmail/Office365 folder name differences, 2) Frontend serializes loadFolders().then(loadMessages) to avoid concurrent IMAP connections, 3) _connect_imap has distinct error messages for decryption vs auth vs connection failures.

_resolve_folder_function.details: Lines 188-218: Function tries exact folder name, then alternatives from FOLDER_ALTERNATIVES dict. Returns None if folder not found.

FOLDER_ALTERNATIVES_constant.details: Lines 178-185: Contains alternatives for sent, drafts, trash, spam, inbox, notes folders. Includes Gmail variants like '[Gmail]/Sent Mail'

_connect_imap_error_handling.details: Lines 151-174: Three distinct error scenarios - 1) Password decryption (500 with helpful message), 2) IMAP auth failed (401), 3) Connection failed (500)

get_email_messages_missing_folder.details: Lines 407-412: When _resolve_folder returns None, returns empty array with folder_missing:true instead of 400 error

frontend_serialized_loading.details: Line 45: loadFolders().then(() => loadMessages()) - serializes IMAP requests

frontend_loadMessages_error_handling.details: Lines 89-98: Handles non-OK response by setting empty messages, logs warning

frontend_loadFolders_fallback.details: Lines 65, 69: Falls back to ['INBOX'] on error or non-OK response

api_404_for_nonexistent_account.details: Endpoints /folders and /messages return 404 'Account not found' for non-existent account IDs

email_client.py.lines_151-174: _connect_imap with improved error handling - decryption, auth, connection failures
email_client.py.lines_178-185: FOLDER_ALTERNATIVES dict with gmail/office365 folder name variants
